system.description:
Favoured weapon: Whip

Granted power: Advantage on saves vs charm and fear. Once/day, your Smite's healing goes to you instead, equal to half the damage the hit dealt.

Allegiance: Chaotic Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Nocticula in the World of Arneyan wiki.
